description.blurb: S/2020 S 1 is a natural satellite of Saturn, belonging to the Inuit group. It was discovered in 2020 and announced in 2023.
description.more: S/2020 S 1 is about 4 kilometers in diameter and orbits Saturn at an average distance of 11.3 million km in 451.1 days. It has an inclination of 48.2° to the ecliptic in a prograde direction with an eccentricity of 0.337.
